schema: Accenture Connected KPI Evidence Governance Contract Specification
organization: Accenture Decision Intelligence Platform / Signal Story
description: Defines multi-source connected KPI stories, evidence roles, dimensional alignment keys, and epistemic guardrails across ERP, Marketing Telemetry, Pricing, Inventory, and CRM/Support sources.

OUTCOME_KPI.name: Primary Business Outcome
OUTCOME_KPI.description: The primary business performance metric experiencing an anomaly or strategic deviation (e.g., Gross Invoiced Sales, Category Share).

CORROBORATING_KPI.name: Corroborating Business Metric
CORROBORATING_KPI.description: Secondary transactional metric from the primary domain that co-moves with the outcome (e.g., Order Volume / Shipped Units, Return Volume).
CORROBORATING_KPI.epistemic_status: Validates that the outcome anomaly reflects genuine transactional activity rather than accounting or reporting artifact.

DRIVER_SIGNAL.name: Operational Driver Telemetry
DRIVER_SIGNAL.description: Cross-domain operational metric indicating potential operational mechanisms (e.g., Marketing Spend escalation, Conversion Rate collapse, Competitor Price Gap expansion).
DRIVER_SIGNAL.epistemic_status: Aligned operational signal whose timing and dimensional scope coincide with the outcome anomaly.

CONTEXTUAL_SIGNAL.name: Qualitative / Market Context
CONTEXTUAL_SIGNAL.description: Unstructured or semi-structured signals (e.g., CRM notes, customer support logs, sales calls) that provide situational context.
CONTEXTUAL_SIGNAL.epistemic_status: Contextual corroboration supporting driver plausibility or eliminating competing hypotheses.

gross_sales.name: Gross Sales
gross_sales.grain: Monthly by Market, Customer, Product Code

order_volume.grain: Monthly by Market, Customer, Product Code

conversion_rate.grain: Monthly by Market, Product Code, Campaign, Channel

click_through_rate.grain: Monthly by Market, Product Code, Campaign, Channel

cost_per_click.grain: Monthly by Market, Product Code, Campaign, Channel
